printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right.
row_scope: All explicit nonstop rows within the selected headings; connecting and through itineraries not transcribed or counted.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily, X excludes listed weekdays; 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not arrival-date rollover.

special_cases.DEN–DFW: 230/461 Saturday only; 812/695 except Saturday. Saturday departures of 230/461 occur after the window closes; both reviewed schedules therefore generate zero window movements.
special_cases.Houston: I suffix identifies Intercontinental, H identifies Hobby, per both city headings; 21 physical schedules split across IAH and HOU.
special_cases.historical_airports: Existing AUS-MUELLER and DEN-STAPLETON markers retained; no modern replacement airport introduced.
